title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Matthew 23: what the scribes and Pharisees do to be seen, the woes Jesus speaks against them, and his words over Jerusalem.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the words and the works of the scribes and Pharisees?
questions.explanation: He said to observe and do whatever they tell you to observe, but not to do their works, because they say and do not do.

answers.text: To do neither their words nor their works
To observe what they say, but not to do their works
To follow them in everything they do
To keep away from them completely

questions.text: What did Jesus say they do to be seen by men?
questions.explanation: He said they do all their works to be seen by men: they make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments.

answers.text: They give their money in the streets
They fast where everyone can see
They sound a trumpet before their gifts
They make their phylacteries broad

questions.text: What did Jesus say they love?
questions.explanation: He said they love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues, the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called Rabbi by men.

answers.text: The best seats in the synagogues
Long journeys to distant cities
Silver and fine garments from the nations
The courts of the governor

questions.text: Why did Jesus tell them not to be called Rabbi?
questions.explanation: He said not to be called Rabbi, because one is their teacher, the Christ, and they are all brothers.

answers.text: Because the scribes had taken that title
Because no one may teach in the synagogues
Because one is their teacher, the Christ
Because the title belongs to the prophets

questions.text: What did Jesus say happens to whoever exalts himself?
questions.explanation: He said that whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

answers.text: He will be humbled
He will be called least of all
He will be shut out of the synagogue
He will be given a greater burden

questions.text: Which did Jesus say is greater, the gold or the temple?
questions.explanation: He called them blind fools and asked which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold.

answers.text: The gold that lies in the temple
The temple, which sanctifies the gold
The altar and the gift upon it
Neither the gold nor the temple

questions.text: Which weightier matters of the law had they left undone while tithing mint, dill, and cumin?
questions.explanation: He said they tithe mint, dill, and cumin but have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith.

answers.text: Sacrifice, fasting, and prayer
Teaching, giving, and healing
Honor, obedience, and tithes
Justice, mercy, and faith

questions.text: What picture did Jesus use for the blind guides?
questions.explanation: He called them blind guides who strain out a gnat and swallow a camel.

answers.text: They carry water in a broken jar
They lead sheep into the sea
They strain out a gnat and swallow a camel
They light a lamp and cover it

questions.text: What did Jesus compare them to, beautiful on the outside but full of dead men's bones within?
questions.explanation: He said they are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful but inwardly are full of dead men's bones and all uncleanness.

answers.text: Whitened tombs
Empty wine presses
Broken cisterns
Locked storerooms

questions.text: What picture did Jesus use for how he would have gathered Jerusalem's children?
questions.explanation: He said that he would often have gathered her children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and they would not.

answers.text: As a shepherd carries a lamb on his shoulders
As a hen gathers her chicks under her wings
As a farmer binds his sheaves
As a mother carries her child in her arms
